source.publisher: MHCLG Energy Performance of Buildings Register / public building records
source.title: Canary Wharf office building roster (per-row provenance in notes)

_method: Identity and physical constants for the estate's office buildings, harvested 2026-08-29. Floor areas and completion years come from the public record named in each row's note; EPC ratings are whole-building certificates on the non-domestic register, read from the certificate pages (URLs are find-energy-certificate.service.gov.uk/energy-certificate/<number>). A building with only per-unit or expired certificates carries no rating, and the note says what the register does hold. Where the cited area was published in m² it is converted at 1 m² = 10.7639 sq ft, with the original stated. Every building here is real; the fictional demo holding lives in config/watchlist.yaml, never in this file.

buildings.name: One Canada Square
buildings.note: Area, year, floors: Wikipedia (One Canada Square). Multi-let (~40 tenants). No whole-building EPC; recent office-unit certificates run B-C, e.g. Level 48 rated B(47), lodged 2024-03-06, cert 5858-5454-8969-6191-4276.

buildings.name: 8 Canada Square
buildings.note: Area (164,410 m² converted), year, floors: Wikipedia (8 Canada Square). EPC D(82), whole building, lodged 2021-06-17, cert 1963-8707-6013-8950-5549. HSBC sole occupier, vacating at the 2027 lease expiry; 1.1m sq ft reworking has planning lodged.

buildings.name: 25 Canada Square
buildings.note: Area is the EPC whole-building figure (134,322 m² converted; Wikipedia publishes only the 1.8m sq ft Citigroup Centre total combined with 33 Canada Square). Year, floors: Wikipedia (Citigroup Centre). EPC D(83) lodged 2016-10-21, expires 2026-10-20, cert 9725-3060-0262-0290-9721. Citi EMEA HQ, refurbishment underway.

buildings.name: 33 Canada Square
buildings.note: Linked half of the Citigroup Centre. Area is the EPC whole-building figure (83,474 m² converted), rating D(100), lodged 2025-10-01, cert 3450-7891-0984-6114-2193. Year, floors: Wikipedia (Citigroup Centre).

buildings.name: 20 Canada Square
buildings.note: Area: Buildington (48,978 m²); year, floors: Wikipedia (20 Canada Square). EPC D(97), whole building, lodged 2019-06-06, cert 0290-2498-6530-1100-1103. In receivership since 2023; formerly BP and S&P Global.

buildings.name: 5 Canada Square
buildings.note: Area (46,450 m² gross, converted), year: Wikipedia (5 Canada Square); storeys 15 (infobox says 16). No current whole-building EPC — the 2012 E(122) expired 2022; current part-building certificates run D-E. Bank of America principal tenant.

buildings.name: 15 Canada Square
buildings.note: Area (gross office), year, floors: Wikipedia (15 Canada Square). Whole-building EPC B(47) of 2010 EXPIRED 2020-04-22 (cert 0240-3936-0380-0260-5050); nothing current on the register. KPMG UK HQ on a 25-year lease.

buildings.name: 25 Bank Street
buildings.note: Area (97,546 m² GFA, converted), year, floors: Wikipedia (25 Bank Street). No office EPC on the register for the tower. JPMorgan European investment-bank HQ, owner-occupier since 2010.

buildings.name: 40 Bank Street

buildings.name: 20 Bank Street

buildings.name: 10 Upper Bank Street

buildings.name: One Churchill Place
